{
  "name": "game-save-point",
  "displayName": "GAME MODE · Save Point",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "/save writes an RPG save screen of the session (cleared, quest log, decisions, resume prompt, items); the next session offers the resume prompt on Tab",
  "author": {
    "name": "Reason of Moon",
    "url": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods/tree/main/plugins/game-save-point",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "game-mode",
    "handoff",
    "resume",
    "summary"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "intensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intensity",
      "description": "off shows saves as plain text; casual and hardcore draw the save screen",
      "default": "casual",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "casual",
        "hardcore"
      ]
    },
    "palette": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Palette",
      "description": "nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)",
      "default": "nes",
      "options": [
        "nes",
        "gameboy",
        "amber",
        "theme"
      ]
    },
    "maxAgeDays": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Offer saves up to (days)",
      "description": "A new session offers the project's latest save when it is at most this old",
      "default": 14,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 365
    }
  }
}
